Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vinod - 32 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Pallavi - 29 years, princess, daughter
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress

Places

1. The battlefield - tents, flags, dust

Scene 1: The battlefield - Day

[Vinod stands on the battlefield. Pallavi stands near him.]

Vinod: "What lovely weather!"

[Wounded, Vinod staggers and drops to one knee.]

Vinod (gently): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Struck by the arrow, Vinod falls and dies.]

Pallavi: "No… this cannot be!"
